DEFAULT_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
NETWORK_ERROR: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your network connection.
REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The request timed out or was cancelled.
HTTP_400: Invalid request. Please check your information (400).
HTTP_401: Your session has expired or is invalid (401).
HTTP_403: You do not have permission to perform this action (403).
HTTP_409: Data already exists or a conflict occurred (409).
HTTP_429: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes (429).
HTTP_500: Internal server error. Please try again later (500).
HTTP_503: Service is temporarily unavailable or overloaded (503).
HTTP_504: Gateway timeout. Server response timed out (504).
